title: Service Optimization Specialist
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* We are seeking a dynamic and future-ready Invoice & Cost Control professional to lead financial governance, transport cost control, analytics, and digital transformation activities within Service Operations & Technology (SO&T).
* This role goes beyond traditional invoice processing—it combines financial control, data analytics, digitalization, process optimization and cost intelligence to enable accurate, efficient, compliant, and data-driven transport operations.
* As a key member of the Service Operations & Technology (SO&T) team, you will play a critical role in end-to-end logistics invoice validation, payment governance, transport cost control, GST compliance, financial reporting, supplier reconciliation, and analytics. You will leverage digital tools and data-driven insights to identify cost leakage, improve process performance, strengthen controls, and support sustainable business growth.

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Financial Control & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with Internal Control (IC) processes for Logistics Service Provider (LSP) invoice processing and payment.
* Ensure LSPs submit invoices on time, accurately, and in compliance with statutory and tax requirements.
* Validate invoices using the 3-Way Matching Principle and ensure appropriate financial controls are maintained.
* Ensure all mandatory supporting documents are uploaded and maintained in SAP before invoice processing.
* Record, monitor, analyze, and resolve invoice disputes by coordinating timely escalations with LSPs and relevant stakeholders.
* Reconcile outstanding supplier statements of accounts within agreed timelines and obtain No Due Certificates (NDC) from LSPs.
* Ensure compliance with GST regulations through GST reconciliation, exception analysis, and timely resolution of discrepancies.

**Cost Management & Business Performance**

* Collaborate with Transport Controllers and Business Control teams to ensure accurate monthly provisions, accruals, freight costs, and transport volumes.
* Analyze transportation costs, premium freight, rush shipments, accessorial charges, and other cost deviations to identify cost leakage and improvement opportunities.
* Perform variance analysis, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, and cost-driver analysis to support business decision-making.

**Data Analytics & Digital Transformation**

* Act as a data-driven finance and cost-control partner, using analytical methods to identify trends, anomalies, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and management reports using digital reporting platforms.
* Combine financial, invoice, transport, supplier, and operational data to provide end-to-end cost and performance insights.
* Participate in digital transformation projects from process assessment and requirements definition through implementation, testing, adoption, and benefits realization.

**Strategic Projects & Cost Improvement**
The role will take ownership of strategic and time-bound projects based on business priorities, with a strong focus on cost optimization, analytics, and financial improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead freight cost analysis and benchmarking across Group companies and operating companies to identify cost drivers, performance gaps, and opportunities for cost optimization
* Analyze dealer pricing versus actual/average transportation costs to identify price variances, under-recovery, negative margins, and potential financial losses, and recommend actions to improve cost recovery and avoid recurring losses.
* Group Company Price Analysis for Common Parts, Analyze pricing of common parts across Group Companies to identify significant price variations and cost drivers.
* Track project progress, financial impact, and benefits realization, ensuring agreed actions are implemented and improvements are sustained.

**Critical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of financial controls, invoice validation, accounting processes, logistics operations, and transport cost management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to interpret large and complex datasets.
* Ability to perform variance analysis, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, forecasting, and cost-driver analysis.
* Strong understanding of data visualization, KPI management, and management reporting.
* Digital mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, AI, analytics, and process digitalization.
* Strong knowledge of GST compliance, statutory requirements, monthly closing, accruals, and audit support.
* Ability to translate data and analytical outputs into business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to lead and influence digital and process transformation initiatives in a changing environment.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to balance speed, accuracy, compliance, and business value.

**Digital & Data Skills**

* ERP systems
* Power BI/Microsoft 365
* Data visualization and dashboard development
* Data extraction, transformation, and analysis
* Automated reporting and workflow solutions
* Understanding of RPA and intelligent automation
* Exposure to process mining and digital process optimization
* Basic understanding of data governance and data quality principles

**Qualifications**
University degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or Business Management.
  
  

* 3- 5 years of relevant experience in finance operations, logistics finance, transport accounting, invoice processing, or shared services.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP (Finance/Logistics modules)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (especially Excel), Power BI, QlikView/Qlik Sense, and other data visualization tools.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Senior Specialist - Power BI
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**ROLE**
.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Leadership
  
  

* Act as the Power BI and BI Subject Matter Expert across Enterprise Solutions.
* Drive the evolution of enterprise BI capabilities using Power BI and modern data platforms.
* Collaborate with business leaders to define analytics strategies and roadmaps.
* Promote adoption of advanced analytics, AI, and self-service BI capabilities.
* Establish and enforce BI governance, standards, and best practices.

Solution Architecture & Delivery
  
  

* Design and deliver enterprise-grade Power BI reporting and analytics solutions.
* Define, build, and maintain semantic data models and reporting frameworks.
* Ensure performance optimization, scalability, reliability, and security of BI solutions.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure compliance with established standards.
* Balance business requirements with sustainable and scalable technical architecture.

Data Management & Quality
  
  

* Own and maintain enterprise Power BI datasets and semantic models.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, reconciliation, validation, and governance practices.
* Develop trusted and reliable reporting solutions across the organization.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to align reporting and data platforms.

Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to BI developers.
* Review development quality and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Partner with business analysts, stakeholders, and IT teams to deliver value-driven reporting solutions.
* Drive a culture of quality, innovation, and zero-defect analytics delivery.

**Required Skills & Experience**
Technical Skills
  
  

* Expert-level experience with Microsoft Power BI (Desktop, Service, Dataflows; Microsoft Fabric experience preferred).
* Strong expertise in SQL programming and database development.
* Advanced knowledge of data modeling, including Star Schema and Dimensional Modeling.
* Experience designing and governing enterprise BI architectures.
* Strong understanding of analytical reporting frameworks and modern data platforms.

Leadership Skills
  
  

* Proven experience leading or mentoring small technical teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive BI adoption.
* Experience acting as a technical SME within enterprise environments.

What Makes You Successful
  
  

* Self-motivated and proactive learner.
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
* Excellent collaboration and teamwork skills.
* Confident communicator with business and technical stakeholders.
* Passion for exploring new technologies, methodologies, and analytical capabilities.
* Adaptable to evolving business priorities and dynamic environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Additional certifications in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Azure, or Microsoft Fabric.
* Experience with additional programming languages and analytics technologies is an advantage.
* Understanding of organizational policies, ethics, and business culture.

**We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.**
In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
  
  
**More lives saved – more life lived!**

title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering
description:
BetaNXT
   

  

 The Company
   

  

 BetaNXT is the next wave in wealth management technology and outsourcing solutions. We focused on solving our customers most demanding integration challenges with flexible, efficient, connected solutions. Our products reduce enterprise cost, streamline operation processes, increase advisor productivity, and enhances the investor experience. Together with BetaNXT, wealth management firms are transforming their platforms into differentiating assets that enable scale and commercial growth.
   

  

 But we're not just invested in our customers; we're also invested in people. We know that our overall success is a combined effort, and we therefore strive to provide opportunities for our employees to learn, grow and thrive.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 BETA is a self\-clearing securities processing solution for wealth management firms. Built on years of expert knowledge and hands\-on experience, BETA provides critical back\-office controls including corporate action management, middle office exception management, and front office account management and trading tools for advisors.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Associate with hands\-on experience in production\-level, cloud\-hosted data\-as\-a\-service application. In this role, you will primarily work on data warehousing\- involving data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL processes including hands on in Data Build Tool (DBT) or any such build tools. You will be responsible for querying using SQL,write functions and stored procedures, and more. On any given day, you might be architecting data ingestion and warehousing solutions, and delivering data to our customers or internal applications through queries and functions. You will follow best practices in code and design, secure coding practices, and review data architecture, modeling, and queries from development through to completion in a live production environment.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development , this role is part of a Scrum team for developing product (s) within the Data Platform team . The role will be involved with developing customer facing cloud hosted data as service products . This role necessitates meetings and require heavy collaboration within and across many teams . Our business model is hybrid, working from our B angalore campus.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Architect and implement data ingestion and warehousing solutions.
* Develop and maintain data models, ETL, and reverse ETL processes.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
* Ensure best practices in code and design, including secure coding practices.
* Review and improve data architecture, modeling, and queries.
* Deliver data solutions to customers and internal applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to meet project goals.


 Your Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in a data\-related software engineering role.
* Experience in Snowflake, DBT models.
* Hands\-on experience with coding, analytical, and data querying knowledge.
* Experience with all phases of the software development life cycle and Agile software development.
* Solid design knowledge to create extensible, reusable data deliveries that meet architectural objectives and security assessments.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and quickly get up to speed.
* Ability to work autonomously and in teams.
* Excitement for new technologies and challenges of scale.
* Proficiency in:
* Data Build Tool (DBT) or any analogous tool
* Data warehousing, including data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL
* SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures
* Various data delivery methodologies (files, streams, APIs)
* Understanding of data\-related application SDKs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools like Terraform.
* Familiarity with AWS
* Knowledge of programming languages such as Python and PowerShell.


 As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. Therefore we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world−regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law.
